listing.name: Blinding-class Super Battlecarrier 0.2.4.
listing.summary: So, the original creator of the Blinding (previously known as the Underlord) gave me permission to post my own version as its own thing, and so...I'm doing that here.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a powerful Remnant super battlecarrier with multiple variants to challenge fleets.

description:
So, did you open Starsector today and think to yourself "man, I really want to go fight some Remnants, but they just don't have anything that'll probably give my fleet a hard time and make me regret existing in the same battlespace!".

Well look no further, because say hello to the

Blinding

-class Super Battlecarrier, a ship with enough weapons to maybe make your Onslaught turn around and ask "why? why would you do this to me?" and enough fighter wings to make a Legion probably feel

ever

so slightly inadequate!

Coming in

four ComSec error, quarantine initiated

three variants all probably-not-guaranteed to make you ask yourself if going into that high warning system (or, if you have Ruthless Sector, going outside the Core Worlds in hyperspace...basically anywhere) was

really

worth the risk, this ship hates you and it is absolutely going to make that your problem... or, if you manage to destroy and (with the help of a certain skill or certain XOs if you've got Second In Command) use it for yourself, then it'll hate you just that

little

bit less than it hates your enemies.

...or something like that, I dunno, I don't pretend to know what the hell goes on in the electronic mind of whatever Alpha Core is piloting this thing.

Now, I could tell you what those variants are and what they do...but I think I'll just let you figure that out on your own.

Fleet Anchor, Siegebreaker, Orbit Clearer.

Download the Blinding-class Super Battlecarrier today, and probably regret your decision immediately!

Yes, the salesman pitch was absolutely 100% necessary, lmao. I assure you.

Credits:

-Kyris/Kyris Kyria, who actually made the damn ship (aka sprited it) in the first place and gave me permission to post my version of the mod here. I just suggested a new name (it was previously called the "Underlord") and wrote the description.

-Me, OmegaEntertainment, who gave the Blinding its new name, wrote the description for it, created two of the

four

three variants (with some pretty okay modifications to the original), and decided to post my version (with permission, as aforementioned) for your enjoyment and possible regret.

Sidenote: I'd have included a picture of the Blinding, but I have no clue how to actually do that or what site I'd use to host the image, so...

shrug

.
